title: DevFlow AI
subtitle: Autonomous Code Intelligence & Security Analysis Platform
overview: DevFlow AI is an architectural framework engineered to automate software quality, security vulnerability auditing, and automated test-case generation through static AST extraction and LLM-assisted reasoning.
problemStatement: Engineering teams spend hundreds of hours manually diagnosing static code issues, writing boilerplate regression test suites, and performing repetitive code reviews, frequently letting subtle edge-case race conditions and security vulnerabilities slip into production.
proposedSolution: An integrated platform combining AST parsing, static analysis, automated unit-test synthesis, and ephemeral sandbox execution governed by resource quotas to verify tests before creating pull request feedback.
implementedFeatures: Repository architecture structure with modular microservices/monorepo layout
Express.js & TypeScript API server scaffolding with Zod validation
Python AI core service scaffolding for static AST inspection
BullMQ job queue schemas for asynchronous task management
Isolated container sandbox specifications for safe test execution
plannedFeatures: Dynamic gVisor kernel sandboxing under high concurrent load
Automated GitHub App webhook-driven inline diff feedback
architectureNotes: Frontend UI (React/Vite) communicates via HTTP/WS to a Core API Server (Node.js/Express) which enqueues tasks to Redis/BullMQ. Background workers trigger Python AI Core for AST extraction and ephemeral Docker sandboxes for isolated execution.
verificationNotice: Source code repository verified on GitHub. Core architecture and service scaffolds are implemented; full cloud execution pipeline is under active iterative development.

title: EduReach
subtitle: Agentic College Information & Guidance Assistant
overview: An AI-powered full-stack academic assistant platform featuring an Agentic RAG chatbot and interactive student portal for admissions, courses, mentors, and campus life.
problemStatement: Prospective and current college students struggle to navigate dispersed institutional websites, conflicting syllabus documents, and complex admission criteria across department silos.
proposedSolution: A unified student portal backed by an Agentic RAG system that pulls from verified institutional knowledge bases to answer complex inquiries on fees, courses, placements, and campus mentors.
implementedFeatures: Node.js 24 + Express 5 backend with TypeScript strict compilation
React 19 + Vite frontend client styled with Tailwind CSS
MongoDB & Mongoose schemas for knowledge management and user states
JWT token authentication and secure password hashing with bcryptjs
LangChain integration pipeline with Google Gemini LLM API
plannedFeatures: Automated PDF syllabus ingestion and vector similarity chunking
architectureNotes: React 19 frontend connects via REST API to Express 5 backend. Server integrates LangChain text splitters and MongoDB vector stores to ground LLM completions on verified campus documentation.
verificationNotice: Backend and frontend codebases verified in public GitHub repository.

title: AI Resume Analyser
subtitle: NLP-Driven Resume Parser & Domain Recommendation Engine
overview: A machine learning and natural language processing tool designed to parse resume PDF documents, extract domain capabilities, match candidate skills, and generate tailored career development paths.
problemStatement: Candidates often submit generic resumes without understanding how their profile aligns with specific technical domain benchmarks or which skills they need to prioritize.
proposedSolution: A streamlined application leveraging NLP extraction to evaluate resumes, classify candidates into target domains, and generate structured skill recommendations with persistent historical tracking.
implementedFeatures: Streamlit interactive web dashboard for single-click PDF resume uploads
Natural language extraction pipeline using spaCy NLP and PyResparser
Relational candidate logging and course data tracking with MySQL
Domain classification logic matching keywords against technical job profiles
Automated skill gap identification and course recommendation display
plannedFeatures: Exportable PDF candidate diagnostic summary cards
Integration with live job posting APIs for real-time requirement matching
architectureNotes: Streamlit frontend ingests resume files, triggers Python NLP parsing routines against uploaded text tokens, persists candidate records to a MySQL relational database, and returns dynamic recommendation cards.
verificationNotice: Fully verified repository on GitHub with working Python source code and database connection modules.

title: RapidCare
subtitle: Emergency Medical Assistance & Resource Navigation Platform
overview: An emergency response assistance platform engineered to provide rapid guidance during medical emergencies, including nearby hospital discovery and first-aid instructional procedures.
problemStatement: During critical medical emergencies, individuals frequently experience panic and struggle to locate verified nearby emergency care facilities or actionable step-by-step first-aid guidance.
proposedSolution: A lightweight web application offering instantaneous access to crucial emergency protocols, instructional triage media, and geo-located healthcare facility directories.
implementedFeatures: Application architecture with React and Vite frontend foundation
Emergency situation categorization and triage instructional layout
Responsive UI built with Tailwind CSS for high-stress mobile usability
Backend REST structure with Node.js and Express.js
plannedFeatures: Live GPS geolocation hospital proximity mapping
Offline cached emergency protocol guides via service workers
architectureNotes: React + Vite SPA communicating with Node.js/Express backend, with Cloudinary for instructional media delivery and MongoDB for hospital facility records.
verificationNotice: Private / local development codebase. Repository is currently maintained locally and awaiting public release.

title: MountainSafe AI
subtitle: Intelligent Mountain Road Safety & Hazard Prevention Concept
overview: A planned conceptual safety intelligence system designed to model accident hotspots, blind-curve risks, and terrain hazard vulnerabilities in mountainous transit corridors.
problemStatement: Mountain highways suffer high fatality rates due to severe blind curves, unpredicted rockfalls, dense fog, and lack of advance situational awareness for commercial and civilian drivers.
proposedSolution: A proposed multi-modal intelligence platform synthesizing historical accident reports, elevation contours, and weather radar feeds to compute real-time hazard indexes for mountain routes.
implementedFeatures: Conceptual system architecture and domain problem research
Technical specification of required sensor inputs and GIS mapping layers
Hazard metric categorization framework (blind-curve, rockfall, weather severity)
plannedFeatures: GIS geospatial hazard mapping using OpenStreetMap and elevation data
Machine learning model training for landslide susceptibility prediction
Real-time precipitation and fog telemetry API integration
architectureNotes: Architecture design envisions an ingest worker aggregating meteorological APIs, road elevation contours, and historical police accident records to render interactive route risk overlays.
verificationNotice: STRICT STATUS: Concept / Planned Development. No machine learning models, prediction engines, or live sensor feeds have been implemented yet. Presented as an engineering research initiative.
